                              First Deputy Commissioner

     Issuance Date:           December 3, 2014

            Purpose:          This bulletin prospectively rescinds 31 Buildings Bulletins (BBs) and 14 Technical Policy and
                              Procedure Notices (TPPNs) that are not applicable to projects filed under the 2014 New York
                              City Construction Codes.

          Subject(s):         Buildings Bulletin, prospectively rescinded; TPPN, prospectively rescinded


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

The following documents are to be prospectively rescinded:
         Buildings Bulletins 2008-002, 2008-004, 2008-005, 2008-010, 2008-011; 2009-006, 2009-007, 2009-010, 2009-
         011, 2009-013, 2009-014, 2009-018, 2009-019, 2009-021, 2009-027; 2010-004, 2010-005, 2010-012, 2010-019,
         2010-021, 2010-024, 2010-27, 2010-028; 2011-011, 2011-013, 2011-017, 2011-025; 2012-006, 2012-007; 2014-
         004, 2014-005
         TPPNs 7/88, 8/88, 9/88, 3/92, 9/92, 3/98, 9/98, 2/99, 3/00, 4/00, 1/02, 3/03, 1/05, 1/07

Prospectively rescinded documents are not applicable to projects filed under the 2014 New York City Construction
Codes. They will appear on the Department website with the watermark “ONLY FOR PROJECTS FILED BEFORE 12-
31-14; SEE BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2014-015.” (The referenced BB 2014-015 gives more detail on the effective
date of the 2014 Construction Codes.)

Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in future
bulletins.

Watermarked BBs and TPPNs may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at:
http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/buildings_bulletin.shtml
